cards.title: Weapon and 2 abilities
cards.text: Each run starts with a pick: a weapon, and 2 of Spawn, Dash and Burst. Then the first module.
cards.why: Your rule: 3 actions in. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details:
Version 0.14.0. Close and reopen the app twice to get it.

Dash, if you bring it, is on the button; the other ability takes the stick. Your last pick is remembered.

parts.title: The pick
parts.text: Tap a weapon, tap 2 abilities (a third swaps out the older one), Go.

parts.title: Controls
parts.text: Without Dash, Burst takes the button: a tap throws at the nearest enemy, a drag aims it.

cards.title: Burst
cards.text: A thrown bomb: drag to aim (further drag, further throw), let go; it blasts where it lands.
cards.why: The new ability. Every module works on it.
cards.details:
12 cells at most, stops short of walls, 3-cell blast for 30, back in 5 s.

Modules: Extra = more bombs round the aim, Bounce = hops on smaller, Home = steers onto an enemy near the aim, Pierce = blasts through walls, Grow = bigger, Haste = sooner, Split = two small bombs after, Knock = hurls everyone out, Explode = a second blast, Duration = further, and the statuses hit everyone in it.

cards.title: Laser
cards.text: Hold to fire a burning beam. It drains a charge and refills when you let go.
cards.why: The new weapon. Every module works on the beam.
cards.details: 18 cells, 42 damage a second. Pierce burns through enemies, Bounce reflects off walls, Extra fans more beams, Split forks it partway, Home bends it onto a nearby enemy, Explode blasts at its end, statuses build a little each instant.

cards.title: Polish
cards.text: Bodies fly off the way they were hit, softer cloud motes, a glow under the shard.
cards.why: Your notes from the juice deck. More polish keeps coming.

parts.title: Deaths
parts.text: The body spins off the way the killing blow went and shrinks away; its sparks go that way too.

parts.title: Motes
parts.text: Fewer, round, small, fading in and out.

parts.title: Shard glow
parts.text: A soft gold glow under the stars.
